name: kiro-starter-kit
description: Kiro CLI starter configurations distributed via the Claude Code plugin marketplace format.

plugins.name: kiro-code-reviewer
plugins.description: Orchestrated PR code review agents for the Kiro CLI: an orchestrator plus six specialists (code-reviewer, code-simplifier, comment-analyzer, pr-test-analyzer, silent-failure-hunter, type-design-analyzer).

plugins.name: kiro-code-reviewer-v2
plugins.description: Orchestrated PR code review agents for the Kiro CLI: an orchestrator plus six specialists (code-reviewer, code-simplifier, comment-analyzer, pr-test-analyzer, silent-failure-hunter, type-design-analyzer).

plugins.name: dotnet-test-creator
plugins.description: Polyglot unit-test generation via an orchestrated Research → Plan → Implement → Validate agent pipeline, with deep .NET test-framework skills (MSTest/TUnit authoring, migrations, CRAP scores).

plugins.name: dotnet-test-creator-v4
plugins.description: Polyglot unit-test generation as a Kiro workflow (kiro-cli 2.26.0+, KAS engine) built on the current dotnet-test plugin: test-engineer entry agent, then Research → Plan → repeat[Implement, Validate] gated on a verdict file, handing off through .git/testagent/ so nothing is ever stageable. Ships the vendored dotnet-test skills.

plugins.name: feature-engineering
plugins.description: Builds features via an engine-enforced Spec → Probe → Design → Plan → Build → Validate pipeline that refuses to advance on a vague spec or disproven understanding, and loops when built code drifts from the plan.

plugins.name: code-review-max
plugins.description: Max-effort, recall-mode code review as a Kiro workflow for native Windows with no Python: eight parallel finder angles, per-candidate verification, a gap sweep, re-votes on unstable verdicts, then ranked findings and postable Conventional Comments.
